measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.service_time_scope: service_ns sums per-task/owner completion spans, which may overlap; it is neither elapsed wall time nor data-bus busy time. resource_totals contains actual per-resource occupied time and bytes.
dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

model_structure.preset_notes: Public config.json fields; bf16 storage bytes are derived analytically.

decode_measurement.semantics: Real prefill fully executes. Common decode window starts after the last prefill batch and all first tokens; numerator counts only later committed decode tokens. TBT pairs stay within one request. Standard TPOT retains the complete first-to-last-token interval.
